text:
Situation: Protamine sulfate 10 mg/mL, 5 mL vial inventory is 293 vials (31.1 days) at Corvale East and 160 vials (14.9 days) at Corvale General as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show protamine sulfate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the earlier shortage first posted on 2021-04-20 has been resolved. FDA inspected the linked Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plant (FEI 1450022) on 2020-05-18 (OAI), 2022-06-30 (OAI), and 2023-08-24 (VAI).

Our position: No national shortage exists. Local supply is limited, particularly at Corvale General. We are monitoring vendor allocations and inter-site transfer feasibility.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy buyer to request updated allocation schedules from Fresenius Kabi and authorized distributors; Director of Pharmacy must approve.
2. Pharmacy buyer to evaluate emergency inter-site transfer from Corvale East to Corvale General; Director of Pharmacy must approve.
3. Pharmacy buyer to identify and qualify alternative 10 mg/mL, 5 mL vial sources; P&T Committee must approve formulary addition.
4. Director of Pharmacy to notify OR and cardiac surgery leads of current days-on-hand status for situational awareness; no approval required.

Not recommended: Initiating conservation protocols, dose rounding, or therapeutic alternatives at this time.
